name: Wei Lim
bio:
Wei Lim's passion for motorsport ignited during Singapore's inaugural F1 race in 2008. He pursued a degree in Data Science at the National University of Singapore, specializing in predictive modeling and statistical analysis. After graduating, he worked as a data scientist for a major logistics firm, honing his skills in optimization and forecasting. He transitioned to motorsport, initially volunteering as a data logger for local racing teams.

Wei's analytical prowess and meticulous approach quickly earned him recognition. He joined Garage 59 two years ago, where he focuses on race strategy optimization, tire degradation analysis, and driver performance evaluation. He believes that data-driven decisions are crucial for gaining a competitive edge in modern motorsport, constantly seeking new and innovative ways to extract insights from vast datasets. His demanding nature pushes his team to constantly refine their methodologies and strive for excellence.

Wei's distinctiveness lies in his ability to translate complex data into actionable strategies. He is a firm believer in the power of visualization and communication, ensuring that drivers and engineers alike can understand and utilize his findings. He's become an invaluable asset to Garage 59, known for his rigorous analysis and commitment to performance improvement.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a lean build and often sports a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten formulas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workstation, down to the millimeter.
